verdict.line: You lose if you eat Corrosive Charge poke before level 3 and let Urgot stack a solo-kill lead; you win once you land W into E and your Sunfire/Thornmail power spike online.

brief.thesis: This is a measured 52% Ornn win rate over 945 games and it plays like it: Urgot's only engage or escape tool is E (Disdain), a 475-range dash on a 16-14s cooldown, and everything about this lane hinges on whether that's up. Before level 3, Urgot's 800-range Q (Corrosive Charge) poke gives him the solo-kill edge the data shows. From level 3 on, Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) Brittle into E (Searing Charge) knockup is the strongest forced trade in the matchup and flips lane shape toward you.

theirWindow.when: E is up and you're overextended pre-6
theirWindow.what: Urgot can land Q (Corrosive Charge) to slow you, then Disdain in to stop on you and unload Purge with Echoing Flames procs. Back off the wave until his E is confirmed down.

yourWindow.when: his E is down and you're level 3+
yourWindow.what: Walk up and land W (Bellows Breath) for Brittle, then E (Searing Charge) into the terrain behind him for the shockwave knockup. With no Disdain to escape or interrupt the trade, this is your best forced engage all lane.

powerCurve.note: Q poke outranges you before E unlocks
W-Brittle into E knockup now live
his full-build execute threat matches your tankiness

start.why: 52% win rate over 727 games and the 64.6% pick — the regen and poke-damage reduction directly answers Urgot's auto-attack and Q harass before E is online.

boots.why: 50.7% win rate over 965 games and 89.3% pick — Urgot's damage is entirely physical (basic attacks, Echoing Flames, Q, Purge), so flat reduction on autos matters more than tenacity here.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (64.1% over 39 games); the burn punishes Urgot for standing in range during Purge channels.
Urgot's whole kit is auto-attack and Purge reliant, making the grievous wounds and reflect damage directly counter his main damage source.
Caps the highest-sample build path and stacks resists so you keep scaling past the point where lane is decided.

situational.when: you need more sustain to shield through his Q/auto poke in a longer lane
the enemy team shifts toward magic damage later in the game

runes.keystoneWhy: Every auto trade heals and permanently grows your health, which is the standard scaling answer in this even, poke-based matchup and matches the highest-sample page (52.9% win rate, 20% pick).

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite carries the best measured win rate in this matchup at 54.3% (21.8% pick). Since the data gives Urgot the solo-kill edge, Ignite lets you punish the one all-in window you get instead of letting him walk away from a losing trade.

playing.title: Track Urgot's E cooldown
playing.detail: Disdain is his only engage and his only escape, on a 16-14s cooldown. Every decision to shove, trade, or back off should start with whether it's up.

playing.title: Trade through Disdain with W
playing.detail: Per the matchup data, use W (Bellows Breath) to push through his E charge rather than dodging it — Ornn's tankiness means you can eat the dash and still land Brittle.

playing.title: Chain W-Brittle into E knockup
playing.detail: Once Brittle lands from W's final gout of flame, follow immediately with E (Searing Charge) into nearby terrain for the shockwave knockup. This is your biggest trade swing from level 3 on.

playing.title: Respect Q poke pre-level 3
playing.detail: Urgot's 800-range Corrosive Charge is his only ranged tool before you have E to answer it. Hold position and let him commit instead of walking into slow range.

playing.title: Call ganks off R at level 6
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God applies Brittle at range (2500) with no real escape for Urgot once his own E is down. Ping your jungler the moment you see his Disdain used.

playing.title: Ignore R's execute panic
playing.detail: Per OP.GG, Fear Beyond Death deals no damage on its own — it only kills you below a health threshold. Just keep your HP above that line instead of flinching from the impale.

playing.title: Play for your item spike
playing.detail: Sunfire Aegis and Thornmail directly punish his auto-reliant kit. Survive to mid build and the matchup tilts from even to clearly yours.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Ignore Urgot’s (E) charge with [W]. Urgot’s (R) does not deal any damage as it only kills you if you are below a certain level of health. Make sure to manage your health well.
